budget.hardware_limits: Unchanged NEXT_RUN_POLICY and existing capped/native guards. Any preparation/verification must use the appropriate established capped class.

anchor_date_screen.scope: Anchor120 observed-M1 support only. Not final all-head eligibility; exact auxiliary-label and sampled-Exit supports remain required.

calendar.reason: Fixed first nine versus final three calendar months of existing latest-year TRAIN; chosen without reading prices/targets/outcomes. Control is not newly pristine research data.

decision.economic_required: All-selected marked economic mean and one-position result must both beat FLAT0 after costs, with uncertainty/censoring disclosed; negative or incomplete evidence does not justify expansion.
decision.failure: Reject expansion and preserve the fixed result. No same-control retuning, loss/threshold search, extra epochs or automatic restart.
decision.later_required: All four aggregate Entry/Exit-by-side paired MSE contrasts versus initial and TRAIN-constant have negative upper95% week-block bounds; centered improvement and action distributions must support state dependence. Report every month; unclear or contradictory transfer is not a pass.
decision.success_limit: At most evidence for this bounded reused-development experiment; not an eternal model, deployment approval, TEST opening or full epoch/VAL authority.
decision.training_required: Both Entry and Exit, both directions, improve over initial and TRAIN-constant baselines with centered conditional error improvement; pure mean shift or class collapse does not pass.

hypothesis: Observed continuation Q_mu at the Entry anchor, shared with Exit supervision, can produce state-dependent learning beyond a cost-only frozen teacher bridge; chronological unexposed initialization/preprocessing is required to assess transfer.

implementation_blockers.minimum_direction: Explicitly bound fresh-prefix experiment branch in the existing native owner; retain old path and guards unchanged.
implementation_blockers.observed: Strict recipe forces completed_smoke_ema_then_fresh_main_optimizer_ema_scheduler and preserved old normalization.

implementation_blockers.minimum_direction: For this explicit mode, route anchor observed reference targets through existing first-state and Entry bridge owners. Keep existing mode byte/semantics compatible.
implementation_blockers.observed: Reference traces are rejected on anchor_views; Entry still reads raw frozen anchor Q.

implementation_blockers.minimum_direction: Bind prefix eligibility and physical fit populations using existing builders; no metadata relabeling or future population fitting.
implementation_blockers.observed: Latest-year selection alone does not restrict future state/label support or inherited full-TRAIN transforms.

implementation_blockers.minimum_direction: Explicit source-TRAIN/logical-development-control lineage with CONTROL256 hashes inside existing native campaign; no alternate runner or TEST source.
implementation_blockers.observed: Current fixed June VAL population bindings do not represent a later TRAIN-sourced development control.

initialization.ema: Fresh copy of online and existing epoch-horizon rule based on eligible prefix population.
initialization.exit_value_head: Use existing close-now zero-value initialization; this is an initial estimate, not a true terminal or economic target.
initialization.online: All learned modules freshly constructed in existing architecture; no old backbone, readout, EMA, task weights or optimizer loaded.
initialization.optimizer: Fresh existing AdamW parameter groups, learning_rate0.0001,weight_decay0.0001; neutral existing trainable task log-variances; existing scheduler rule.
initialization.selection_variant: ONLINE at fixed step256, not best checkpoint or EMA selected after outcomes.
initialization.target: Copy exact fresh online state once, freeze through the bounded comparison; no target refresh.

measurements.economic: Only after learning criteria pass, evaluate same frozen final snapshot/cohort in existing bounded native evaluator. Include all selected Entries, costs, cash and executable marks for open positions, and one-position replay; no winners-only report. This requires a separately bound native window, not permission from this design.
measurements.later_control: Same fixed target estimand and snapshot pair on CONTROL256. Report LONG/SHORT Entry and Exit separately, state0 and sampled states, and each calendar month/week. Compare initial model, fixedTRAIN mean and all-FLAT economics.
measurements.training: Paired initial-versus-fixed-final ONLINE predictions on the bound TRAIN probe, identical frozen targets and masks. Entry/Exit LONG/SHORT MSE, centered MSE, target/prediction variation, actions and gradient movement; all-FLAT/all-HOLD alone fails.
measurements.uncertainty: One predeclared paired calendar-week block bootstrap,5000 draws,seed20260911; no resampling choice search. Descriptive development uncertainty, not untouched-test significance.

required_before_any_native_run: Exact eligible TRAIN population and4096-row/sample order; all auxiliary/Exit target-support proofs
Prefix base/context/MTF/lifetime normalization artifacts and zero-control-fit proofs
Fresh online/target/EMA/optimizer hashes and parentage without exposed weights
Bound TRAIN256 probe and fixed target cache hashes
Focused tests for anchor consistency, future-boundary rejection, no inherited weights, normalization population and resume/source binding
Existing capped/native hardware guards and a new narrowly bound run policy; training_enabled remains false until those facts exist

selection.control: existing deterministic_uniform_subsample_indices on time-sorted control population
selection.missing_targets: Do not replace chosen control entries after inspecting outcomes; retain masks/censoring and report incomplete measurement.
selection.train: existing native full-population epoch0 order filtered by prefix eligibility, never a fixed replay or outcome-ranked sample
selection.training_probe: Freeze256 IDs from actual planned4096 eligible TRAIN entries before optimizer steps, using the same existing selector salt0. Required binding still missing.

targets.auxiliary_heads: Retain all existing heads/objectives, but bind each label support and mask before fitting; no loss-weight search or future-label reuse across cutoff.
targets.entry: Materialize the same reference trace at state0 and use executable initial liquidation plus max(valid anchor HOLD Q_mu,0) for each side; FLAT=0. Pass through existing first-state/Entry target owners with detached values and bindings.
targets.entry_exit_consistency: Same observation support, costs, gamma, reference policy and frozen boundary teacher for a matching anchor; never mix old greedy-teacher bridge with newly observed Exit targets.
targets.exit: Reuse build_reference_policy_hold_targets for identical liquidation-relative HOLD Q_mu and EXIT_NOW=0 at fixed sampled states.
targets.limitations: This learns a declared stationary reference continuation value, not optimal Q or proven profitable trading. Zero fresh-teacher boundary prior leaves tail uncertainty; preserve and report observed and bootstrap components.

temporal_contract.bootstrap: Teacher input boundary must also be at or before cutoff for TRAIN. Preserve valid bootstrap and true censoring/economic terminal masks. Control labels may use later observed data only within their declared data boundary, never for fitting.
temporal_contract.input_context: Historical warmup before train start is allowed; every input row must be available at decision time. No controlled future rows in normalization fitting.
temporal_contract.normalization: Refit all shared base/context/MTF and lifetime-summary transforms on eligible prefix-only physical populations with the existing owners; zero control/June/TEST fit rows. Record exact physical row support and hashes.
temporal_contract.supervision: Every TRAIN Entry auxiliary label and observed Exit/reference reward support must end at or before cutoff. Purge crossing supervision before sampling; do not shorten market lifecycles or create synthetic terminals. Bind eligibility by clocks/policies, never outcomes.
temporal_contract.trading: Calendar boundaries constrain learning/evaluation information only. No forced liquidation or maximum holding time is introduced.
